objective: For G = UT3(F4) x| C3 with action (w^2 x, w^2 y, w z) and a closed orientable 3-manifold M, prove that |Hom(pi1 M, G)| is a sum over maps psi to C3 of |B^1|^2 |Z^1(F4_w)| times the number of pairs (a, b) in V = H^1(M; F4_{w^2}) with T(a, b, c) = 0 for all c, where T is the twisted triple product <a u b u c, [M]>, a symmetric F4-trilinear form; equivalently |V|^-1 times a cubic character sum. With H1(M) = Z/3 this gives |Hom| = 1 + 128 4^d N(T), d = dim V.
status: Proved by TRIPLE-PRODUCT-20261026-001A-P001: for G = UT3(F4) x| C3 and a closed orientable 3-manifold M, the maps over a surjection psi to C3 number |Z^1(F4_w)| |B^1(F4_{w^2})|^2 N(T), where T(a, b, c) = <a u b u c, [M]> is the twisted triple product, a symmetric F4-trilinear form on V = H^1(M; F4_{w^2}), and N(T) = #{(a, b) : T(a, b, .) = 0} = |V|^-1 sum (-1)^{tr T(a,b,c)}; with H1(M) = Z/3, |Hom| = 1 + 128 4^d N(T). Checked against brute force on six knot surgeries.
title: Counting maps is a twisted cubic Gauss sum
